mapper.sql: select message_code as "messageCode", message_type as "messageType", user_message as "userMessage", created_at as "createdAt", created_by as "createdBy", updated_at as "updatedAt", updated_by as "updatedBy" from message_codes

where.if: and (message_code ilike concat('%', #{messageCode}, '%') or user_message ilike concat('%', #{messageCode}, '%'))

mapper.select: order by message_type, message_code limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
mapper.insert: insert into message_codes (message_code, message_type, user_message, created_by, updated_by, change_reason) values (#{messageCode}, #{messageType}, #{userMessage}, #{userId}, #{userId}, #{changeReason}) on conflict (message_code) do update set message_type = EXCLUDED.message_type, user_message = EXCLUDED.user_message, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, change_reason = EXCLUDED.change_reason
